facts: The standing plan has a smaller eastern court and a trapezoidal western court. The tower stands along the south front, which combines two ranges with repeated high pointed windows, smaller pointed transoms and stone doorways. Four corner towers surround the belfry roof.
The restoration of the front and attached Nieuwerck range was completed in June 2025, and the final scaffolding came down.
The uploader Poliphilo identifies himself as Tony Grist, the named author in his first own-work public-domain posting.
